text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After finishing my work for the morning,
I make
my way to the cafeteria to get
some lunch.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: This weather's perfect for a picnic!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
It really is. Do let me know if any of you
fancy a
nap. You can lay your head in
my lap anytime. ♪

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Why would anyone sleep now? We're
about to
chow down here. Anyway, did
everyone bring
their stuff?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Of course! ☆

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Absolutely!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Okay, on three, then. One, two... three!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
On the count of three, everyone takes
out their
lunch boxes and places them
onto the picnic
sheet.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Once the boxes are opened up, I see
that each
one is packed to the brim with
appetizing side
dishes.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Oh, Trainer! Would you like to join us?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Of course. Food tastes way better when
you eat it
together with everyone. ☆

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. Come on over. Do you fancy
anything in
particular? I'll plate it right
up for you.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
And don't hold back! Make sure you eat
up so
you're ready to go all afternoon.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Yep. We like to meet up and share
different
recipes with each other. ♪
choice_data_list: お弁当を持ち寄ってるのか？
お弁当を持ち寄ってるの？
choice_data_list_en: Did you all bring your own lunches?
Did you all bring your own lunches?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Different people show up every time,
but us three
always make sure to come!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I learn so many recipes coming to
these
meet-ups. Like this stuff! It's real
good. Try some!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
These are just roasted yams, but they
taste great
with these seaweed flakes on
top. And the sweet
sauce really brings
out the flavor, too.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
The spring onions paired with the crispy
pork
belly over there have a bit of a
kick, so that
combo's sure to get your
mouth watering. ☆

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Go ahead and eat up! Do you like it?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The bite in the spring onions goes
perfectly with
the fatty pork, while the
seaweed smells homely
and the sweet
sauce infuses me with sheer delight.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I savor the lingering taste of the yams,
which melt
on my tongue like fluffy
velvet. There's only one
way to describe
all this food...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Yay!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
The ingredients and seasonings are
pretty basic,
but it's moreish as hell,
right?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Oh my, look at you, stuffing your cheeks
like
that... Hehehe. You look darling,
dear. But there's
plenty of food left, so
you needn't rush.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Seeing someone enjoy my food so much
makes all
that slaving over a stove
worthwhile.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Trainer! How about we make one of
your
favorite foods for next time? Do
you have any
specific requests?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, steak! Meat's always a good
choice. ☆ It'll
definitely make you
stronger and more energetic,
too!
choice_data_list: 力がつきそうなステーキ！
choice_data_list_en: A steak that'll really build your strength!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
There's nothin' wrong with a simple sear,
but I
wanna take this chance to try out
some other
grilling techniques. How rare
do you want your
steak?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
We could try making various sauces, too!
That'd
be fun. ♪ What kind of sauce
would you like?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe. It feels a little bit special when
you're
making food for a certain
someone. ☆

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Taking one person's preferences into

consideration instead of just making a
dish for
everyone to enjoy... Yeah, this
should be super
fun too!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Come on, you two! Let's put our heads
together
and think up a new steak
recipe!

text_block_list.name: The Three
text_block_list.text: Right!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I spend a lovely afternoon drooling over
the
amazing spread and feeling beyond
grateful for
the wonderful meet-up.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Really? You want something that spicy?
Are you
okay with hot stuff?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Heh, I like that spunk of yours. We'll
make it
extra spicy for ya, so you'd
better show us what
you're made of and
put it all away!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
It'd be nice to have something to
balance out the
heat. Milk would be a
good option, but soy milk
might be
better suited to a packed lunch.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Don't make your meal an ordeal, Trainer! The most important thing is for you to enjoy your lunch! ☆

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
The spicier the curry, the more intense
it'll be,
so...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I've got it! Let's make some lassi to drink
on the
day. And instead of rice, we can
bake some sweet
naan to go with the
curry, and...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I have a lively lunch listening to the
three of them
brainstorming different
recipes.
